description: This file contains an implementation of the AsyncTask class, a utility for managing background tasks and updating the UI thread in Android applications. It includes custom thread pool executors, task lifecycle management, and threading rules, with modifications from the Android framework.

classes.name: AsyncTask
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for performing background operations and publishing results on the UI thread, with custom thread pool executors and task lifecycle management.

classes.name: AsyncTask.Status
classes.description: Enumeration representing the current state of an AsyncTask (PENDING, RUNNING, FINISHED).

classes.name: SerialExecutor
classes.description: A private static class implementing Executor to serialize task execution, running tasks one at a time.

classes.name: WorkerRunnable
classes.description: A private static abstract class implementing Callable, representing the background work to be executed.

classes.name: AsyncTaskResult
classes.description: A private static class encapsulating the AsyncTask instance and its result or progress data.

methods.name: AsyncTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing the background worker and future task.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the AsyncTask.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Abstract method to perform background computation; must be overridden.

methods.name: onPreExecute
methods.description: Method called on the UI thread before background execution; can be overridden.

methods.name: onPostExecute
methods.description: Method called on the UI thread after background execution; can be overridden.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Method called on the UI thread to update progress; can be overridden.

methods.name: onCancelled
methods.description: Method called on the UI thread if the task is cancelled; can be overridden.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the task execution.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Checks if the task has been cancelled.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Starts the task with given parameters on the default executor.

methods.name: executeOnExecutor
methods.description: Starts the task with given parameters on a specified executor.

methods.name: publishProgress
methods.description: Publishes progress updates to the UI thread.
